name: Salatet Batates (Egyptian Warm Potato Salad)

ingredients.name: russet potatoes, about 2 to 3 large potatoes
kosher salt, plus more to taste
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste

instructions.primary_message: Mince the garlic. Juice the lime.
For the Potatoes: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 400°F.

In a medium saucepan, place potatoes, bay leaf, and garlic. Cover with water and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cook until fork-tender but not falling apart, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain well and let them sit until cool enough to handle, about 20 minutes.

Using a clean kitchen towel, gently rub the potatoes to loosen and remove the skin. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces. Transfer potatoes to a rimmed baking sheet and toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Spread potatoes in an even layer and cook until golden and crisp around the edges, about 30 minutes, stirring once halfway through.

For the Dressing: Meanwhile, in a small skillet, heat 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add cumin, coriander, and chile flakes, if using, and cook until very fragrant, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat, and add lime juice, vinegar, and salt. Transfer potatoes to a serving bowl and pour warm dressing over them. Toss gently until potatoes are evenly coated. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste. Top with parsley and serve hot or warm.

not_counted: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste

schema_metadata.keywords: egyptian potato salad, salatet batates, warm potato salad, potato salad without mayonnaise, roasted potato salad

description: This Egyptian potato salad features crisp roasted potatoes tossed in a warm dressing of garlic, cumin, lime juice, and vinegar for a bold, flavorful side dish.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1/2 teaspoon chile flakes (optional); 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves, for serving; Lemon wedges, for serving

Make-ahead and storage: The potatoes can be par-boiled, peeled, cut, and tossed with olive oil for up to 1 day in advance. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 4 days.
While it's not traditional, this salad can be enjoyed cold or at room temperature. To reheat leftovers, spread them on a sheet pan and warm in a 400°F oven until heated through and lightly crisped.
author: Nermine Mansour
